nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Non-Gaussian Bayesian regression model for normative modeling (warped Bayesian linear regression).
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: A non-Gaussian Bayesian regression model was implemented, which accounts for the non-Gaussian distributions of the cortical thickness andsubcortical volume data and adjusts for unwanted noise from scanning acquisition across multiple sites.

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Cortical thickness (148 cortical regions) and subcortical gray matter volumes (20 regions).
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: T1-weighted scans from both the reference and the research dataset were processed using FreeSurfer recon-all cross-sectional, to extract the cortical thickness of 148 cortical regions and gray matter tissue volume of 20 subcortical volumes from the Destrieux parcellations.
nm2_2_response_variable.location: Verdi2024.pdf.md: 2.3 Estimation of cortical thickness and subcortical volumes

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Normative model covariates: age, sex, and site.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: This model was trained on 58,836 scans from datasets across 82 sites to generate normative models per region using the covariates age, sex, and site, as previously described.
